title: Malaysian banks' counter rates for the Singapore dollar, daily since 2021
description: Bank Negara Malaysia's 11:30 am figures for the best counter rates selected Malaysian commercial banks offered for the Singapore dollar, buying and selling, each working day since January 2021.
question: What do Malaysian banks pay and charge in ringgit for Singapore dollars at the counter?

fields.name: banks_buy_myr_per_sgd
fields.meaning: The best rate the banks pay for a Singapore dollar (what you get selling S$ to them).

fields.name: banks_sell_myr_per_sgd
fields.meaning: The best rate the banks sell a Singapore dollar at (what you pay buying S$ from them).
